user_query: My family and I are planning a road trip across Europe. Can you suggest some must-visit cities and attractions in countries like France, Italy, Germany, and Spain? It would be helpful if you could also provide us with the driving directions and estimated travel times between these cities.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of must-visit cities and attractions in France.
Research and compile a list of must-visit cities and attractions in Italy.
Research and compile a list of must-visit cities and attractions in Germany.
Research and compile a list of must-visit cities and attractions in Spain.
Combine the lists from steps 1 to 4 into a comprehensive itinerary.
Calculate driving directions and estimated travel times between the selected cities from the itinerary.
